workflows.title: Launcher and non-modal dialog navigation
workflows.setup: Reset the fixture and start at the application heading.
steps: Navigate to the review launcher using only the screen reader and keyboard.
Open the review surface and traverse its heading, description, controls, and findings region.
Move between the review Shadow DOM and the host application without using DevTools.
expected: The launcher exposes its expanded state and the review surface is announced as a named non-modal dialog.
Reading order is stable, no interactive control is skipped, and navigation can return to the host page.

workflows.title: Shortcut help and presentation preferences
workflows.setup: Open Review preferences from a fresh fixture.
steps: Read the keyboard shortcut reference and ownership notes.
Operate theme, marker color, clear-after-copy, interaction blocking, docking, and wireframe fade controls.
Close and reopen preferences using keyboard navigation.
expected: Every control has a stable name, current state, and reachable help text.
Letter shortcut guards and Escape ownership are understandable without relying on visual tooltips.

workflows.title: Element finding draft lifecycle
workflows.setup: Reset the fixture and focus Broken action.
steps: Start element marking and select the focused host button.
Complete the requested-fix and success-criteria fields, then save the draft.
Open the draft from its marker, update it, and delete it from the editor.
expected: Marking instructions, editor labels, save confirmation, marker action, update, deletion, and focus restoration are announced once and in context.

workflows.title: Text, rectangular region, and freehand capture
workflows.setup: Reset the fixture before each capture type.
steps: Create a finding from selected text and inspect the resulting editor.
Create a rectangular region finding and inspect its geometry description.
Create a freehand finding and cancel or save it from the normal editor.
expected: Each capture mode announces activation, cancellation, and the correct target kind without trapping focus or activating the host control.

workflows.title: Keyboard multi-selection
workflows.setup: Focus Broken action before choosing Mark multi.
steps: Press Enter to add the first target and move to Host interaction probe for the second.
Confirm the bounded count announcements and finish with Shift+Enter.
Cancel once during collection and once from the completed editor using Escape.
expected: Host controls are not activated, focus remains in the application during collection, counts are announced once, and cancellation restores the documented focus owner.

workflows.title: Layout placement and rearrangement authoring
workflows.setup: Reset the fixture and enter Layout Mode.
steps: Search the component catalog, choose a component type, and create a page or wireframe placement.
Select Layout source section, choose rearrangement, and describe a destination region.
Adjust wireframe fade and cancel an incomplete layout operation.
expected: Catalog results, source selection, canvas, geometry, purpose, mode state, and cancellation are operable and announced without implying that the page DOM was mutated.

workflows.title: Marker visibility, structured copy, and clear controls
workflows.setup: Create at least two local drafts.
steps: Hide and show one marker, then hide and show all markers.
Select drafts and invoke Copy Markdown and Copy JSON.
Toggle clear-after-copy and use Clear drafts.
expected: Marker state, selected count, copy success or failure, and destructive clear scope are announced with finding-specific control names.

workflows.title: Deterministic contract and advisory design candidates
workflows.setup: Activate Seed contract and design candidates in the fixture controls.
steps: Review, cancel, and dismiss the contract candidate.
Review, retarget, save as a draft, and dismiss the advisory design suggestion.
Confirm the two candidate sources remain distinguishable.
expected: Candidate source, authority, target, action names, editor context, and dismissal are announced without presenting advisory output as a verdict or repair authorization.

workflows.title: Single, selected, and all finding submission
workflows.setup: Create three drafts and leave at least two selected.
steps: Submit one draft with Send and auto-fix.
Submit the selected drafts in visible order.
Create new drafts and submit all.
expected: The submitted scope and result are announced once, controls do not claim an agent outcome, and remaining independent drafts retain their state.

workflows.title: Agent clarification and human reply
workflows.setup: Submit one finding, choose Clarification needed in fixture controls, and apply the state.
steps: Read the agent question and open its finding-specific reply editor.
Cancel once, then reopen, enter a response, and send it.
Return to the repair item and review the thread order.
expected: Question attribution, reply label, cancellation, send confirmation, thread order, and restored focus are announced without replaying the complete finding list.

workflows.title: Review-ready human actions
workflows.setup: Submit one finding, choose Human review ready in fixture controls, and apply the state.
steps: Navigate the Accept, Reject, and Reopen actions for the specific finding.
Exercise each action on a reset copy of the fixture.
Confirm the action remains a request until an authoritative repair event arrives.
expected: Each action includes the finding instruction in its name, confirmation is scoped, and no action announces a terminal state before the fixture applies one.

workflows.title: Resolved, dismissed, cancelled, and failed repair states
workflows.setup: Submit one finding and use Reset fixture between each target state.
steps: Apply Resolved, Dismissed, Cancelled, and Failed from the fixture controls in separate runs.
Read the actor, status, available follow-up action, and thread for each state.
Reopen a terminal finding where the product permits it.
expected: Every terminal state is announced once with its finding context and only valid follow-up actions remain reachable.

workflows.title: Focus restoration and hide-until-restart
workflows.setup: Focus Host interaction probe before opening the review surface.
steps: Close the idle panel with Escape and confirm application focus.
Delete or send a focused draft and confirm a durable review control receives focus.
Activate Hide until tab restart and reload the tab.
expected: Focus returns without scrolling to a connected application control when the Shadow DOM disappears, and the launcher returns only after a tab restart.

workflows.title: Polite live-announcement scope
workflows.setup: Create drafts and one submitted repair before changing states.
steps: Trigger selection counts, draft saves, submissions, repair updates, and copy results one at a time.
Listen after each update without moving the virtual cursor.
Navigate the findings list after the announcements finish.
expected: Each bounded status message is announced once, unrelated findings are not replayed, and the findings list remains independently navigable.

workflows.title: Explicit host interaction blocking
workflows.setup: Open Review preferences and focus Host interaction probe.
steps: Verify normal host interaction with blocking disabled.
Enable page pointer blocking and attempt pointer, wheel, and context-menu interaction on the host page.
Continue keyboard and screen-reader navigation through both host and review controls.
expected: The blocking state is announced, only documented pointer-class input is suppressed, and keyboard or screen-reader navigation is not trapped.
